title: Many senders, one close
hints: Every worker closes results when it finishes. The second close panics ("close of closed channel"), and any worker still sending panics too ("send on closed channel").
With several senders, close only once, after all of them are done. Wait for the workers with a WaitGroup in one extra goroutine, then close.
go func() { wg.Wait(); close(results) }()  — and remove the close from the workers.
